steps.code: (() => { const vp=document.querySelector('[aria-label="对话内容"]'); window.__probe={t0:performance.now(),s:[]}; window.__probe.timer=setInterval(()=>{ window.__probe.s.push([Math.round(performance.now()-window.__probe.t0), vp?vp.scrollHeight:-1, vp?Math.round(vp.scrollHeight-vp.clientHeight-vp.scrollTop):-1, document.body.innerText.length]); },120); return vp?'probe-on':'no-viewport'; })()
